macro:
-_RunPythonScript (

import rhinoscriptsyntax as rs
import scriptcontext as sc
import math

StepSize = 0.05
if  ('WALKABOUT_STEPSIZE') in sc.sticky:
    StepSize  = sc.sticky['WALKABOUT_STEPSIZE']
    
C = rs.ViewCamera()
T = rs.ViewTarget()

Cnew = C
Tnew = T

Dx = T.X- C.X
Dy = T.Y- C.Y

Dist = math.sqrt(Dx*Dx + Dy*Dy)

Cnew.Z = Cnew.Z - Dist * StepSize
Tnew.Z = Tnew.Z - Dist * StepSize

rs.ViewCameraTarget (rs.CurrentView(), Cnew, Tnew)
)
